name: 017_session_open_long_tf5
hypothesis: The London and New York opens are when the day's concentrated order flow arrives: desks that must trade the session open cross the spread, and the pre-session range is the agreed reference price they cross. R1.0 measured that idea 005's edge was entirely its long leg (+0.1275 R on 212 validation trades, gross +0.3088, positive in both 2023 and 2024) while its short leg was a coin flip, so this idea takes the session break long only. It also fixes what 005 could not afford: 005 paid cost_r 0.1813 because a 2.5x ATR stop on 15m is under 1% of price and was crossed as taker, so the stop here is a fixed fraction of price and the entry is a post-only limit. [Timeframe variant of 017_session_open_long, 15m -> 5m, mode chart: same bar counts and ATR multiples, hold x0.333333, pct stop x0.577.]
